links.outcome: Consistency of answers across repeated regenerations of the same questions
links.effect: High concordance (92.06%) across three trials, with considerable consistency in regenerating answers.
links.quote: The model demonstrated high concordance (92.06%) and satisfactory validity.

links.outcome: Correctness and completeness of clinical knowledge in open-ended OHNS board questions
links.effect: Passing mark averaging 75% across three trials, but responses were often only partially correct, with hallucinations and self-conflicting answers observed.
links.quote: While demonstrating considerable consistency in regenerating answers, it often provided only partially correct responses.

unlisted_practices: CVSA (concordance, validity, safety, accuracy) model for evaluating open-ended medical board exam answers

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 performance on sample Otolaryngology board exam questions using a newly proposed assessment framework (CVSA) without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
